# amiga-os reference index

Every public function of exec, dos, graphics, intuition, diskfont, utility, layers and
lowlevel, the timer/input device functions and the cia/potgo resources (AmigaOS 3.9
NDK), with LVO and register assignments generated from the NDK SFD files, plus the
timer, input and audio device commands.

- [Sources](SOURCE.md) · [Errata](errata.md)

## Guides

- [Calling convention: library bases, LVOs and registers](topics/calling-convention.md) — Every Amiga shared library, device and resource is reached through a *base pointer*.
- [Memory rules](topics/memory-rules.md) — Exec has no memory protection and no resource tracking: whatever a program allocates stays allocated until it frees it (or the machine reboots), a stray write lands in someone...
- [Opening libraries, devices and resources](topics/opening-libraries.md) — Before a program can call any OS function it needs the right base pointer.
- [Core exec structures](topics/structures.md) — The exec structures you read and fill in most often, with exact C field names, asm labels and offsets.
- [Tag lists](topics/taglists.md) — From V36 on, most OS calls that need many optional parameters take a *tag list*: an array of (tag, data) longword pairs ended by `TAG_DONE`.

## Device commands

- `AbortIO` (timer.device) — Cancel a pending TR_ADDREQUEST so it is replied at once with `IOERR_ABORTED`. → [timer/commands.md](timer/commands.md#abortio)
- `ADCMD_ALLOCATE` (audio.device) — Allocate one of several channel combinations, stealing lower-precedence ones if needed. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#adcmd_allocate)
- `ADCMD_FINISH` (audio.device) — End the writes in progress, immediately or at the end of the current cycle. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#adcmd_finish)
- `ADCMD_FREE` (audio.device) — Release allocated channels: reset them and make them available to other allocations. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#adcmd_free)
- `ADCMD_LOCK` (audio.device) — Keep allocated channels from being stolen until you free them. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#adcmd_lock)
- `ADCMD_PERVOL` (audio.device) — Change period and volume of the writes currently playing on the selected channels. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#adcmd_pervol)
- `ADCMD_SETPREC` (audio.device) — Change the allocation precedence of channels you own. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#adcmd_setprec)
- `ADCMD_WAITCYCLE` (audio.device) — Wait until the write playing on one channel completes its current cycle. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#adcmd_waitcycle)
- `CMD_CLEAR` (audio.device) — No operation for audio (there are no caches); it only checks the allocation key. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_clear)
- `CMD_FLUSH` (audio.device) — Abort every playing and queued write, and every pending ADCMD_WAITCYCLE, on the channels. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_flush)
- `CMD_READ` (audio.device) — Find which write request is currently playing on a channel. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_read)
- `CMD_RESET` (audio.device) — Return channels to a known state. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_reset)
- `CMD_START` (audio.device) — Resume stopped channels, starting all selected channels at the same moment. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_start)
- `CMD_STOP` (audio.device) — Pause the selected channels at once; new writes queue until CMD_START or CMD_RESET. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_stop)
- `CMD_UPDATE` (audio.device) — No operation for audio (there are no buffers to flush); it only checks the allocation key. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_update)
- `CMD_WRITE` (audio.device) — Play a sample on one channel, repeating it a given number of times. → [audio/commands.md](audio/commands.md#cmd_write)
- `IND_ADDHANDLER` (input.device) — Insert an input handler into the input stream at the priority in its Interrupt node. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_addhandler)
- `IND_REMHANDLER` (input.device) — Remove a handler previously added with IND_ADDHANDLER. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_remhandler)
- `IND_SETMPORT` (input.device) — Choose which controller port input.device reads the mouse from. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_setmport)
- `IND_SETMTRIG` (input.device) — Set the conditions under which the mouse port produces a report. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_setmtrig)
- `IND_SETMTYPE` (input.device) — Tell input.device what kind of controller is on the mouse port. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_setmtype)
- `IND_SETPERIOD` (input.device) — Set the interval between repeats of a held key. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_setperiod)
- `IND_SETTHRESH` (input.device) — Set how long a key must be held before it starts repeating. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_setthresh)
- `IND_WRITEEVENT` (input.device) — Feed one input event into the input stream as if it came from a device. → [input/commands.md](input/commands.md#ind_writeevent)
- `TR_ADDREQUEST` (timer.device) — Wait for a time interval, or until an absolute time, then reply the request. → [timer/commands.md](timer/commands.md#tr_addrequest)
- `TR_GETSYSTIME` (timer.device) — Read the system time through a device request. → [timer/commands.md](timer/commands.md#tr_getsystime)
- `TR_SETSYSTIME` (timer.device) — Set the system time. → [timer/commands.md](timer/commands.md#tr_setsystime)

## All functions (alphabetical)

- `AbleICR` (cia -18) — Enable or disable CIA interrupt sources and return the previous enable mask. → [cia/cia.md](cia/cia.md#ableicr)
- `AbortIO` (exec -480) — Ask the device to cancel a request that is in progress. → [exec/io.md](exec/io.md#abortio)
- `AbortPkt` (dos -264) — Ask a handler to abort a packet sent with SendPkt; currently does nothing. → [dos/packets.md](dos/packets.md#abortpkt)
- `ActivateGadget` (intuition -462) — Make a string or custom gadget active so the user can type without clicking it first. → [intuition/gadgets.md](intuition/gadgets.md#activategadget)
- `ActivateWindow` (intuition -450) — Ask Intuition to make a window the active (input-receiving) window. → [intuition/windows.md](intuition/windows.md#activatewindow)
- `AddAnimOb` (graphics -156) — Link an AnimOb into an animation list and add all its components' Bobs to the gel list. → [graphics/gels.md](graphics/gels.md#addanimob)
- `AddBob` (graphics -96) — Add a Bob to the RastPort's gel list (sets its system flags, then links its VSprite). → [graphics/gels.md](graphics/gels.md#addbob)
- `AddBuffers` (dos -732) — Grow or shrink a filesystem's block buffer cache. → [dos/dos-list.md](dos/dos-list.md#addbuffers)
- `AddClass` (intuition -684) — Make a class created with a public name visible to NewObjectA by ID. → [intuition/boopsi.md](intuition/boopsi.md#addclass)
- `AddDevice` (exec -432) — Link a ready device into the system device list so OpenDevice can find it. → [exec/libraries-devices-resources.md](exec/libraries-devices-resources.md#adddevice)
- `AddDosEntry` (dos -678) — Link a device, volume or assign node into the DOS list. → [dos/dos-list.md](dos/dos-list.md#adddosentry)
- `AddFont` (graphics -480) — Add a TextFont you built or loaded yourself to the public system font list. → [graphics/text-and-fonts.md](graphics/text-and-fonts.md#addfont)
- `AddGadget` (intuition -42) — Link one gadget into a window's gadget list at a given position, without drawing it. → [intuition/gadgets.md](intuition/gadgets.md#addgadget)
- `AddGList` (intuition -438) — Link a chain of gadgets into a window or requester gadget list in one call. → [intuition/gadgets.md](intuition/gadgets.md#addglist)
- `AddHead` (exec -240) — Insert a node at the front of a list. → [exec/lists.md](exec/lists.md#addhead)
- `AddICRVector` (cia -6) — Claim one CIA interrupt bit for a handler; fails with the owner if the bit is taken. → [cia/cia.md](cia/cia.md#addicrvector)
- `AddIntServer` (exec -168) — Add an Interrupt node to a shared server chain, ordered by `ln_Pri`. → [exec/interrupts.md](exec/interrupts.md#addintserver)
- `AddKBInt` (lowlevel -60) — Install a routine that runs inside the keyboard interrupt for every key received. → [lowlevel/keyboard.md](lowlevel/keyboard.md#addkbint)
- `AddLibrary` (exec -396) — Link a ready library into the system library list so OpenLibrary can find it. → [exec/libraries-devices-resources.md](exec/libraries-devices-resources.md#addlibrary)
- `AddMemHandler` (exec -774) — Install a low-memory handler that exec calls when an allocation is about to fail. → [exec/memory.md](exec/memory.md#addmemhandler)
- `AddMemList` (exec -618) — Add a new region of RAM to the system free memory pool. → [exec/memory.md](exec/memory.md#addmemlist)
- `AddNamedObject` (utility -222) — Insert a NamedObject into a namespace, by priority. → [utility/namespaces.md](utility/namespaces.md#addnamedobject)
- `AddPart` (dos -882) — Append a file or subpath to a directory path in a buffer, inserting `/` as needed. → [dos/paths-and-names.md](dos/paths-and-names.md#addpart)
- `AddPort` (exec -354) — Put a named message port on the system's public port list so FindPort can find it. → [exec/signals-and-messages.md](exec/signals-and-messages.md#addport)
- `AddResource` (exec -486) — Link a resource into the system resource list so OpenResource can find it. → [exec/libraries-devices-resources.md](exec/libraries-devices-resources.md#addresource)
- `AddSegment` (dos -774) — Add a seglist to the DOS resident list under a name. → [dos/loading.md](dos/loading.md#addsegment)
- `AddSemaphore` (exec -600) — Initialize a named semaphore and publish it on the system semaphore list. → [exec/semaphores.md](exec/semaphores.md#addsemaphore)
- `AddTail` (exec -246) — Append a node to the end of a list. → [exec/lists.md](exec/lists.md#addtail)
- `AddTask` (exec -282) — Start a task from a caller-built Task structure and stack. → [exec/tasks.md](exec/tasks.md#addtask)
